description: Returns change points this service recorded over time for an endpoint (e.g. exchange rates, weather) as compact CSV. Use the same params as the live call. When to use: to see how a live value (e.g. an exchange rate or the weather at a place) changed since this service started recording it. For long official histories use get_series instead. Returns an error if nothing was recorded for these params. Read-only, no API key or signup. Free quota: 1000 calls/day per IP, shared across tools.

apiId.description: Endpoint id; list recorded ones via GET /api/v1/history

params.description: Same params as the live call (omit for the default series)

name: get_history
title: Get recorded endpoint history
